data.one_liner: A NoSQL persistent embedded document-based database for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Sembast stores documents in a single file or in-memory, supporting transactions, encryption via codecs, and change listeners. It works across all platforms without requiring native plugins.
use_when: You need a simple, single-file NoSQL database for local storage
You want support across all platforms including Flutter Web and desktop without native plugins
You need transactional writes and query filtering on JSON-compatible maps
avoid_when: You need complex relational queries or multi-table joins
You are dealing with massive datasets that exceed memory limits, as the database loads entirely in memory when opened
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with 100% platform support
Familiar document-store paradigm with transaction support and change listeners
weaknesses: Loads the entire database into memory when opened
Not suited for complex relational data modeling
data.setup_notes: No native plugin setup required; simply add path_provider to locate the database file on Flutter.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight key-value and box-based NoSQL database optimized for speed.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a traditional relational SQL database for SQLite-supported platforms.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to store simple key-value configuration data.
